notes: WORKED EXAMPLE Net map: 0=bottom rail+V-DC minus via GND symbols 8/11; n1=top +5V rail; n2=zener bias line (left rail below zener + the long horizontal at y~260 that passes UNDER the center column via a crossover hop); n3=center gate column (V-AC 2 top joins it via a T at y~295; column ends at MOSFET 1's gate, it does NOT touch the bottom rail); n4=mid horizontal at y~184 (sources of 10 and 5, drain of 13, top lead of 7; hops over the center column); n5=junction dot node (13 source, resistor left, 1 drain); n6=feedback node (7 gate down-right path, resistor right T-join at x~396, 6 gate); n7=right-edge rail (7 bottom lead to I-AC 4 top); n8=link from 6's other channel lead up-and-over to I-AC 3 top. Judgment calls: (a) both crossings of the center column are hops (semicircular bumps drawn in the column), so the column connects ONLY gate-column members; (b) PMOS 7: top lead taken as source (faces the NMOS source node n4), bottom as drain — S/D choice does not affect net grouping; (c) PMOS 6: channel lead to I-AC 3 taken as drain, grounded lead as source (body arrow tied to source in this drafter's symbol style); (d) Zener 14 drawn with triangle apex toward the bias line, so anode=top rail side, cathode=bias side as drawn (a shunt-regulator reading would expect the opposite; recorded as drawn); (e) V-DC 9 has visible +/- marks: + on left (top rail), - on right (to GND 11); (f) both I-AC sources drawn with upward arrows, top terminal listed first; (g) V-AC sources have no polarity marks - terminal order arbitrary (does not affect metrics).
